description: List the account's email campaigns, newest first, with page-token pagination (`token`, `per_page`). Optionally filter by name with `search`.

per_page.description: Number of campaigns per page. Defaults to 50, maximum 100.

search.description: Filter campaigns by name (case-insensitive partial match), e.g. "spring".

token.description: Page number to retrieve (page-token pagination). Defaults to `1`.

name: list-email-campaigns
